high_level_description: The image depicts a wall-mounted candle sconce with two lit candles. The sconce is ornate, featuring a brass or gold-colored metal frame with intricate detailing. It has three arms, each holding a candle. The central arm holds one candle, while the two outer arms hold another candle each. Each candle is encased in a clear glass holder that appears to be part of the sconce's design. The sconce also includes decorative elements such as small crystal-like pendants hanging from the central arm and larger, scalloped glass pieces at the bottom of the sconce, adding to its elegant appearance.
